sections.title: People and homes in detail: meaning and form
body: Goal: Describe a person and a home precisely with adjective agreement and useful relative clauses.
Core vocabulary: pålitlig, rymlig, en granne. Key phrases: Hon är en pålitlig vän. · Lägenheten har ett ljust kök. · Det är grannen som bor ovanför.

An adjective usually has a basic form with en nouns, a -t form with ett nouns and an -a form in plural or definite phrases: en ljus hall, ett ljust kök, två ljusa rum, den ljusa hallen. Use som to add identifying information: grannen som bor ovanför.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

examples.en: The flat has a bright kitchen.

examples.fi: Det är grannen som bor ovanför.
examples.en: That is the neighbour who lives upstairs.

sections.title: Register, evidence and independent use
body: Register model: “Lägenheten har ett ljust kök.” is a neutral description way to express “The flat has a bright kitchen.”.
For listening and reading, answer from a specific word or phrase. For speaking and writing, make the recipient, purpose and next action clear.
Attempt the task before using the model. Improve one high-impact feature, then perform it again with the transfer condition.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: Where does Aino live? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: Which feature is essential because Nils works from home? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: Describe a person you know and a suitable home for that person. Use en, ett and plural adjective forms. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Write an original 90-word housing profile: who will live there, what the home is like and which features matter most. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: A second person with different needs joins the household; revise the description and priorities.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.
